# unifi_clients (Data Source)

Lists the clients currently connected to a site (wired, wireless, VPN and teleport) via the UniFi **Official API** (`integration/v1`). Read-only. Requires a controller running version 10.1.78 or later with API-key authentication.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List all clients currently connected to the default site (Official API).
data "unifi_clients" "all" {}

# Restrict to a single site and apply an optional server-side filter.
data "unifi_clients" "guests" {
  site   = "default"
  filter = "type.eq('WIRELESS')"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter` (String) An optional Official-API filter expression applied server-side when listing connected clients.
- `site` (String) The name of the UniFi site to query. If not specified, the provider's default site is used.

### Read-Only

- `clients` (Attributes List) The connected clients. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--clients))

<a id="nestedatt--clients"></a>
### Nested Schema for `clients`

Read-Only:

- `connected_at` (String) When the client connected, in RFC 3339 format.
- `id` (String) The UUID of the connected client.
- `ip_address` (String) The client IP address, if known.
- `json` (String) The full client record, including the type-specific `access` payload, serialized as a JSON string.
- `name` (String) The client name.
- `type` (String) The connection type (e.g. `WIRED`, `WIRELESS`, `VPN`, `TELEPORT`).
